brand_lede: Build product-grade floating interactions with the same behavior in Web Components and Vue.
framework_switch_title: Choose the implementation used in each demo.
framework_web_components_title: Web Components — standards-based Custom Elements for any stack.
framework_vue_title: Vue — composables and components for Vue applications.
hero_title: Build the moments around your interface.
hero_copy: Give help, reveal context, guide choices, and protect focus without rebuilding the hard interaction behavior for every feature.
patterns_title: What your product can do next.
patterns_copy: Every pattern is a working interface, not a static mockup. Switch its implementation when you are ready to compare the API surface.
foundation_title: One interaction model. Your own interface.
foundation_copy: This is not a UI kit. It is the foundation for custom overlay components when the primitives in your design system stop short. The examples show what you can build while your product keeps its own markup and visual language.
foundation_state_copy: Use the same interaction rules across Web Components and Vue.
foundation_search_copy: Compose cancellation-aware fuzzy search with your own input, options, and ARIA.
react_path_copy: Building a custom floating interface in React?
packages_title: Start with the UI you build.
packages_copy: Choose Web Components or Vue for an application. The core package powers those adapters and is there when you need to build a new integration.
packages_web_components_copy: Standards-based custom elements for any stack.
packages_vue_copy: Vue composables and components for Vue applications.
packages_core_copy: Use this directly when you are building another framework adapter or a fully custom integration.
pattern_tooltip_heading: Help that follows pointer and keyboard intent.
pattern_tooltip_description: Offer compact, accessible guidance without interrupting the task.
pattern_popover_description: Reveal anchored detail, actions, and dismissal behavior where it matters.
pattern_menu_description: Build keyboard-ready command menus from one collection registry.
pattern_nested_menu_description: Coordinate submenus, focus, and dismissal across a complete action tree.
pattern_client_point_heading: A surface can follow intent, not just an element.
pattern_client_point_description: Position context from pointer coordinates with a virtual reference.
pattern_combobox_description: Search multilingual destinations with fuzzy matching and accessible list navigation.
pattern_placement_description: Compare all typed placements and understand how the surface responds.
pattern_middleware_heading: Position with the constraints you mean.
pattern_middleware_description: See how offset, shift, flip, size, arrow, hide, inline, and auto-placement cooperate.
pattern_modal_description: Trap focus, lock scroll, layer Escape dismissal, and return people where they started.
example_tooltip_build: We build contextual help that stays available to both pointer and keyboard users.
example_popover_build: We keep anchored details connected as the surface moves through the DOM.
example_menu_build: We keep command navigation dependable with one collection registry.
example_nested_menu_build: We keep submenu focus aligned with its parent across a complete command hierarchy.
example_client_point_build: We let context follow a precise pointer position instead of a fixed element.
example_combobox_build: We keep multilingual destination search independent from the UI framework.
example_placement_build: We make placement a product decision that updates the floating surface immediately.
example_middleware_build: We isolate each layout constraint so its effect stays visible in action.
example_modal_build: We layer dialogs with inert surroundings, scroll locking, focus return, and ordered Escape dismissal.
